set.body:
Owners: fit inputs and fmri-workflow orchestration. Acceptance:
- Deterministic pilot selection and finite preparation budget; freeze lambda, sigma/noise preparation, regional centers and nonzero prior spreads before full streaming.
- Pool gradient/Hessian at common reference/chart with score/count/weights; determinant correction contributes per voxel. Sign reversal preserves shape evidence under fixed preparation.
- Distinguish independent likelihood from spatially weighted/composite evidence; no unjustified precision from correlated voxels or prior-dominated curvature.
- Protect held-out/training-fold boundaries. No continuous per-voxel variance-component optimization or implicit extra data passes.
- Reuse typed spatial/region inputs without adding atlas dependencies to fit. JVM+JS deterministic policy tests.
Performance: configured pilot <=2,048 voxels and <=2 preparation passes for B0; emit attempted/evaluated counts and preparation cost. Pilot tuning and reference routing are never charged outside the reported end-to-end budget.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-13: Freeze regional pilot preparation and preserve identification provenance
